cards.card_text: The cry even says, "Become like a juniper in the desert." Then the LORD says Moab will be captured, because Moab trusts in its works and treasures.
cards.verse_text: Become like a juniper in the desert.’ Because you trust in your works and treasures, you too will be captured, and Chemosh will go into exile with his priests and officials.
